categories.title: 🧠 LLM Agentic OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation for language-model agents that execute tools, operate external environments, or exchange task feedback with users and other agents.
categories.desc_zh: 面向执行工具、操作外部环境，或通过用户与其他智能体的任务反馈继续决策的语言模型智能体的在策略蒸馏。

categories.title: 🧩 Multimodal Agentic OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation for multimodal agents with action-observation loops, including visual tools, multimodal search and multi-turn GUI interaction.
categories.desc_zh: 面向具有动作—观察闭环的多模态智能体，包括视觉工具、多模态搜索与多轮 GUI 交互；不纳入仅有静态问答或截图定位的工作。

categories.title: 🤖 Embodied Agentic OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation of policies evaluated through closed-loop robot, driving or embodied software execution, including VLA and world action models.
categories.desc_zh: 面向通过机器人、驾驶或具身软件闭环执行进行评测的策略蒸馏，包括 VLA 与世界动作模型；区分在线环境采样与离线动作策略蒸馏。

categories.title: 🎬 Video Agentic OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation for agents that act on video tools or video-based environments and use the resulting observations; static video QA and temporal grounding alone are excluded.
categories.desc_zh: 面向调用视频工具或在视频环境中执行动作、利用后续观察继续决策的智能体；仅有静态视频问答与时间定位不予收录。

categories.title: 🔊 Audio Agentic OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation for agents in interactive speech, audio-tool or audio-environment tasks; fixed-input ASR, audio QA and affect recognition alone are excluded.
categories.desc_zh: 面向交互式语音、音频工具或音频环境任务中的智能体；仅有固定输入语音识别、音频问答与情感识别不予收录。

categories.title: 🎨 Agentic Generative Systems (AGS) OPD
categories.desc: On-policy distillation for Agentic Generative Systems that plan toward goals, execute generation tools and refine outputs from feedback; generic iterative diffusion distillation is excluded.
categories.desc_zh: 面向 Agentic Generative Systems（AGS）的在策略蒸馏：系统围绕目标规划、调用生成工具，并依据反馈迭代改进输出；不纳入仅有迭代扩散蒸馏的工作。

papers.title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: In multi-turn agentic OPD, student departures can make next-token teacher scores unreliable even when teacher takeovers can still complete the task.
papers.q2: The paper diagnoses myopic scoring and develops reward-free teacher repair to make supervision more useful on difficult student states.
papers.q3: Evaluated on agentic long-horizon tasks; see the paper for the exact environments and student-teacher settings.
papers.q4: Repair quality depends on teacher capability and adds teacher-side computation.
papers.affiliation: NVIDIA

papers.title: ToolOPD: Credit-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Tool-Use Agents
papers.q1: Uniform teacher credit across long tool-use trajectories fails to identify the small number of actions that determine outcomes.
papers.q2: ToolOPD extracts hindsight skills from completed trajectories, converts outcome-sensitive teacher changes into action credit, and jointly reweights OPD with RL.
papers.q3: Long-horizon tool-interaction benchmarks with small language-agent students.
papers.q4: The method depends on outcome summaries and teacher probability access; the paper does not establish coverage beyond the evaluated tool tasks.
papers.affiliation: Northeastern University; Honor Device Co., Ltd.

papers.title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Hierarchical teams receive only indirect final-answer feedback for intermediate search and answer agents.
papers.q2: A frozen teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens while RL supplies team and answer outcomes, jointly training a Leader-Searcher-Answerer system.
papers.q3: Seven question-answering datasets and four-attempt multi-agent solving.
papers.q4: The shared-parameter team and judge quality limit transfer to other agent organizations.
papers.affiliation: Alibaba Group; Zhejiang University

papers.title: Information-Gain Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Deep Search Agents
papers.q1: A search query that looks preferable before retrieval may return poor evidence, so token-level OPD can be blind to post-retrieval information utility.
papers.q2: The method uses information gain after retrieval to reallocate supervision across turns and calibrate query preferences.
papers.q3: Six multimodal search benchmarks, including MMSearch and BrowseComp-VL, with 2B and 4B students.
papers.q4: The calibration requires reliable retrieval utility and may depend on the search environment.
papers.affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; Renmin University of China; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; BAAI

papers.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
papers.q1: Token-level OPD can suffer from state-distribution mismatch and requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenizers.
papers.q2: ActionOPD aligns semantic actions at student-visited states using sampled teacher actions, and Self-ActionOPD adds privileged same-model guidance.
papers.q3: Tool-use tasks with Qwen3 students and black-box or same-model teachers across four out-of-distribution benchmarks.
papers.q4: Action-level agreement may miss useful internal reasoning signals and depends on the action abstraction.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University

papers.title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.q1: In multi-turn agents, prior student reasoning can distort teacher targets while the current reasoning changes which actions are sampled at the same interaction state.
papers.q2: State-OPD grounds supervision in matched interaction states and allocates extra complete reasoning-action samples to high-entropy states.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop with Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students.
papers.q4: State matching and extra response sampling add rollout cost, and the reported environments are simulated.
papers.affiliation: Alibaba Group; Tsinghua University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; USTC

papers.title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Student actions change later observations, so multi-turn trajectories can drift away from the teacher distribution and make token supervision harmful.
papers.q2: STI-OPD samples teacher interventions from a KL-based discrepancy probability and uses importance-weighted reverse KL on the resulting mixed-policy trajectories.
papers.q3: Tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction benchmarks across multiple student sizes.
papers.q4: Interventions trade exploration for reliable supervision and require a calibrated discrepancy signal.
papers.affiliation: Monash University; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Zhongguancun Laboratory

papers.title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.q1: Teacher-student divergence is a poor credit signal in chained decisions because early drift contaminates later contexts.
papers.q2: GraphOPD builds a dependency graph from environment state changes and fuses graph-based structural credit with distributional disagreement.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and SearchQA across three model scales and eleven baselines.
papers.q4: The method needs structured environment records and may be harder to apply to agents without explicit state transitions.
papers.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China; Xiaohongshu; HKUST (GZ)

papers.title: SCAD: Structured Credit Assignment and Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.q1: Sparse terminal rewards obscure intermediate contributions, while OPD can lose useful teacher guidance as student histories grow.
papers.q2: SCAD separates planning from bounded subtask execution, uses local execution distillation, and assigns planning credit through cross-rollout prefix trees.
papers.q3: Text and multimodal long-horizon agent benchmarks.
papers.q4: The decomposition and prefix-tree design may require task structure that is unavailable in arbitrary environments.
papers.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Tsinghua University; Nanyang Technological University

papers.title: Harness-Aware Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
papers.q1: When a fixed harness supplies context, tools and feedback, standard distillation imitates the teacher's full output instead of only the teacher capability missing from the harness.
papers.q2: HAD contrasts teacher actions with and without harness information after the student's own reasoning and filters invalid preference pairs.
papers.q3: Long-horizon agent benchmarks with a shared fixed harness.
papers.q4: The method assumes a stable harness and may not transfer when tool interfaces or feedback semantics change.
papers.affiliation: KAIST AI; Independent researcher

papers.title: Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: A student can outperform its teacher early in agentic OPD and then regress as continued distillation erodes successful student decisions.
papers.q2: The paper diagnoses distillation overshoot and proposes a selective protection mechanism for decisions that the student already executes successfully.
papers.q3: Agentic benchmarks and multiple teacher-student model families.
papers.q4: The protection criterion and its benefit depend on reliable decision-level outcome diagnostics.
papers.affiliation: University of Southern California; University of Florida; Emory University; University of Alabama; University of Maryland; Amazon AGI; Boston University; The Ohio State University; National Taiwan University

papers.title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
papers.q1: A single early action can make a later multi-turn rollout unrecoverable, while ordinary OPD treats all turns similarly.
papers.q2: PivotOPD identifies pivotal mistakes and focuses teacher guidance on recovery after the state-changing error.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-based QA with Qwen3 students, plus transfer to SWE-Bench Verified.
papers.q4: Pivotal-error detection and recovery depend on the environment's notion of success and remaining budget.
papers.affiliation: Princeton University; NVIDIA; University of Maryland

papers.title: Teacher–Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents
papers.q1: Large teacher-student distribution gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical in multi-turn autonomous agents.
papers.q2: OG-OPD weights teacher supervision by paired continuation outcomes rather than local distributional gap alone.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop; the paper reports consistent gains over vanilla OPD.
papers.q4: Outcome pairing increases rollout cost and depends on reliable continuation evaluation.
papers.affiliation: Alibaba; Peking University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai Jiao Tong University

papers.title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
papers.q1: Think-then-act rollouts delay environment interaction because long reasoning is generated before short actions.
papers.q2: ActFirst-OPD uses reference-conditioned inverse dynamics for quick actions, then asynchronously generates full responses for token-level teacher supervision.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and ScienceWorld with Qwen3 students from 0.6B to 4B.
papers.q4: Reference transitions and asynchronous reasoning introduce additional data and scheduling assumptions.
papers.affiliation: Southern University of Science and Technology; Zhongguancun Academy; Hong Kong Polytechnic University; DeepCybo; Nanyang Technological University

papers.title: DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents
papers.q1: Arrival-order batching in asynchronous OPD lets a few long rollouts dominate updates while other student interactions become stale.
papers.q2: DivOPD spreads a fixed turn budget across rollouts and prioritizes turns with cumulative teacher-student disagreement; optional teacher intervention handles no-progress episodes.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop across six teacher-student settings.
papers.q4: Turn selection improves data use but still relies on usable teacher feedback and asynchronous infrastructure.
papers.affiliation: University of Chicago; Meituan; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; HKUST (GZ)

papers.title: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
papers.q1: Long-horizon multimodal search agents need deeper evidence gathering and process supervision than short multimodal questions provide.
papers.q2: MMSearch-OPD refines questions into harder search tasks and combines reward-guided RL with gap-weighted, decaying token-level OPD.
papers.q3: Multimodal deep-search benchmarks with image-question data and long evidence-gathering trajectories.
papers.q4: The refined task distribution and retrieval utility may limit transfer to other search engines or modalities.
papers.affiliation: Peking University; HKUST (GZ); Tsinghua University; The University of Hong Kong; Zhejiang University; Huawei Cloud

papers.title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: GUI agents need visual history for long tasks, but retaining screenshots is expensive and textual compression can discard state-critical evidence.
papers.q2: ECHOES recursively compresses history in a Compression-Think-Action format; privileged multi-image teachers distill student rollouts and balance OPD with task reward.
papers.q3: Four GUI benchmarks plus the ECHOESBMK perception-memory diagnostic benchmark.
papers.q4: Training uses privileged images and teacher updates that are unavailable at deployment.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University; StepFun; Nanyang Technological University; Leapmotor; Honor

papers.title: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.q1: Flow-based VLA distillation faces distribution mismatch both in environment observations and in intermediate action-generation states.
papers.q2: The method couples student-driven environment rollouts with teacher velocity supervision along student-generated action-flow trajectories and combines multiple domain specialists.
papers.q3: LIBERO-40, CALVIN and Meta-World manipulation benchmarks.
papers.q4: Two-level flow supervision and repeated environment interaction may be costly for broader robot platforms.
papers.affiliation: Huawei Technologies; Tsinghua University

papers.title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent: Product-Conditioned Multimodal Policy Learning for Embodied Agents
papers.q1: Embodied agents must translate changing multimodal goals and execution feedback into actions under product constraints.
papers.q2: Staged SFT and multi-teacher OPD precede RL; DPER routes token-level evidence from a privileged teacher and privileged student through the rollout policy.
papers.q3: Robotic platforms and smart-hardware interaction tasks in a closed-loop sandbox.
papers.q4: Product-conditioned trajectory coverage and sandbox evaluation may not represent open-world embodiment.
papers.affiliation: JD.COM

papers.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
papers.q1: Large VLA foundation policies are expensive to deploy, while few-step or compact policies can lose manipulation performance.
papers.q2: FastOPD matches teacher velocity at a student-generated action-flow state and combines this OPD objective with finite-step self-consistency.
papers.q3: LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, World Action Model transfer and real-robot deployment.
papers.q4: On-policy sampling concerns action-generation states; closed-loop robot evaluation does not imply fresh environment rollouts during distillation.
papers.affiliation: KAIST; Sungkyunkwan University

papers.title: VISTA: Internalizing Collective Visual Experience via On-Policy Distillation for Active Multimodal Agents
papers.q1: Active multimodal agents collect complementary visual discoveries across interaction rollouts, but scalar RL advantages discard much of that information.
papers.q2: VISTA aligns observations from same-input rollouts with individual decisions and uses an experience-conditioned teacher to distill successful and failed trajectories.
papers.q3: Active visual-tool tasks and fine-grained perception/general reasoning benchmarks.
papers.q4: The approach assumes useful visual tools and may be sensitive to the diversity of same-input rollouts.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University

papers.title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
papers.q1: Multi-turn VLM agents suffer sparse rewards and unrecoverable pivot actions that ordinary episode-level objectives cannot localize.
papers.q2: PIVOT uses visual trajectory diagnostics to locate pivot steps, re-score failed tokens with privileged context, and combine confidence-gated OPSD with GRPO.
papers.q3: Five multi-turn VLM agent tasks spanning grid puzzles, 3D control, navigation and generative reasoning.
papers.q4: The analyzer and teacher are training-time components, and pivot localization depends on task-specific rollback probes.
papers.affiliation: HKUST (GZ); IDEA; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Nanyang Technological University; Tsinghua University

papers.title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Closed-loop world action models need fresh on-policy histories, making repeated real-robot rollouts expensive during distillation.
papers.q2: WAM-OPD replays a fixed pool of initial-student and teacher interaction histories, refreshes student denoising paths, and uses prefix-weighted teacher supervision.
papers.q3: Simulated and real-world robotic manipulation adaptation with retained general skills.
papers.q4: Environment histories remain fixed during distillation; proxy importance weights only approximate the shift in their distribution.
papers.affiliation: USTC; Zhejiang University; Shandong Normal University; Tencent Hunyuan3D

papers.title: UI-MOPD: Multi-Platform On-Policy Distillation for Unified GUI Agents
papers.q1: GUI agents trained on one platform can fail when action spaces, layouts and interaction conventions change.
papers.q2: UI-MOPD distills multi-platform GUI behavior on student-generated interactions to build a unified compact agent.
papers.q3: Multi-platform GUI benchmarks and cross-platform action prediction.
papers.q4: Platform diversity and visual grounding quality determine transfer.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University

papers.title: VLA-OPD: Bridging Offline SFT and Online RL for Vision-Language-Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: VLA training must bridge offline demonstrations and online interaction without destabilizing action policies.
papers.q2: VLA-OPD transfers teacher action distributions on student-visited observations before or alongside online RL.
papers.q3: Closed-loop robotic manipulation on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0.
papers.q4: The method depends on action-token calibration and simulated-to-real transfer.
papers.affiliation: HKUST (GZ)

papers.title: Refined Policy Distillation: From VLA Generalists to RL Experts
papers.q1: Generalist VLA policies can fall short of task-specific expert performance and are costly to deploy.
papers.q2: RPD guides a compact PPO student with actions from a VLA teacher at student-visited states, combining action matching with on-policy reinforcement learning.
papers.q3: ManiSkill3 manipulation with Octo and OpenVLA teachers; the distilled RL student can outperform its VLA teacher.
papers.q4: This is VLA-to-RL-expert action-policy distillation, not token-level LLM OPD or transfer back into a generalist VLA.
papers.affiliation: University of Technology Nuremberg

papers.title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation
papers.q1: Open-ended image generation agents must search for evidence, select references and compose generation programs instead of mapping prompts directly to images.
papers.q2: GenEvolve compares best and worst tool-orchestrated trajectories and gives structured visual experience only to a privileged teacher for dense student distillation.
papers.q3: GenEvolve-Data, GenEvolve-Bench and public image-generation benchmarks.
papers.q4: Tool coverage and trajectory comparison quality affect self-evolution.
papers.affiliation: HKUST (GZ); Meituan; HKUST; National University of Singapore

papers.title: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
papers.q1: Visual agents interleave image operations and reasoning, so an early acquisition or reading error can corrupt all later evidence and answers.
papers.q2: ReVuE compares multiple student trajectories, diagnoses the first Acquire, Read, or Ground failure, and uses reflection-conditioned token reweighting for OPD.
papers.q3: Eleven visual-agent benchmarks across Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, including tool-use trajectories.
papers.q4: The reflection diagnosis adds rollout and teacher cost and depends on reliable failure-stage identification.

papers.title: Learn How to Act from Your Own Interactions: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Agents
papers.q1: Extending GUI OPSD from grounding to multi-turn interaction is limited by weak privilege following and insufficient memory guidance.
papers.q2: GUI-SD-v2 jointly trains privileged and unprivileged rollouts, then selectively distills step-specific reasoning and memory guidance from the self-teacher.
papers.q3: AndroidWorld and MobileWorld multi-turn GUI-agent benchmarks.
papers.q4: Privilege-following and memory selection are platform-sensitive and require training-time privileged states.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University; Tencent; Chinese Academy of Sciences; Institute of Information Engineering; Nankai University

papers.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.q1: Offline GUI imitation discards the next screenshot even though it often reveals why the current action is correct.
papers.q2: GHD samples student responses on offline interaction prefixes; a parameter-sharing teacher sees the recorded next screenshot and re-scores those responses when hindsight recovers a failed action.
papers.q3: Closed-loop task success on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab across two vision-language models.
papers.q4: The next screenshot is recorded privileged training evidence, not an observation caused by the newly sampled student action during distillation.
papers.affiliation: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

papers.title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
papers.q1: Chunk-level VLA training ignores how a current action changes long-horizon task success, while closed-loop sequence RL is costly for real robots.
papers.q2: DriftOPD matches current-policy action samples to a demonstration-defined target with a drifting reverse-KL surrogate, while an offline critic approximates the future term.
papers.q3: Simulation and real-world manipulation across multiple VLA architectures.
papers.q4: Training uses offline demonstration contexts, no new environment rollouts and no separate teacher; its sequence-level objective relies on a critic surrogate.
papers.affiliation: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology; Sungkyunkwan University

papers.title: Reflect-VLA: Internalizing Reflective Guidance via Dual-Path On-Policy Self-Distillation for Autonomous Driving
papers.q1: Scalar driving rewards identify that a trajectory is poor but do not diagnose whether perception, behavior selection or execution caused the error.
papers.q2: Reflect-VLA treats reflective diagnoses as privileged information, distilling corrective distributions on risky rollouts while self-imitating reliable trajectories.
papers.q3: Driving evaluation on NAVSIM v1/v2 and the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark.
papers.q4: Reflection quality and risk routing are training-time assumptions that may not cover novel failure modes.
papers.affiliation: Tsinghua University; University of Macau; University of Science and Technology of China; Beijing Jiaotong University

papers.title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: A stronger teacher can still fail on particular embodied states, so global imitation can assign credit to harmful corrections.
papers.q2: RE-0 verifies local teacher interventions in the environment and feeds only beneficial counterfactual corrections into RE-OPD, weighted by measured local gain.
papers.q3: Embodied code-as-policy tasks with recursive local improvement and environment verification.
papers.q4: Verification requires environment interaction and can be expensive or brittle when success is difficult to measure.
papers.affiliation: Jilin University; Dalian University of Technology

papers.title: WAM-OPD: Joint Video-Action Supervision for World Action Model Post-Training with On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: World Action Models generate future video and robot actions, but ordinary post-training supervises only one output on histories encountered by the student.
papers.q2: WAM-OPD queries paired video and action targets on student histories and jointly distills both modalities without changing deployed sampling.
papers.q3: Twelve RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and four real-robot manipulation tasks.
papers.q4: Paired teacher video-action queries and simulator-to-robot coverage determine generalization.
papers.affiliation: University College London

papers.title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.q1: Sparse rewards provide weak supervision for high-dimensional autoregressive action policies during online VLA adaptation.
papers.q2: ROAD-VLA builds a proximal action-space teacher by perturbing action logits with calibrated advantages, turning reward information into dense self-distillation.
papers.q3: Seven robotic manipulation environments with in-distribution and shifted conditions.
papers.q4: The policy-improvement guarantee depends on calibrated advantages and accurate teacher matching.
papers.affiliation: UNSW Sydney; Deakin University; United States Air Force Research Laboratory

papers.title: FORCE: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Fine-Tuning via Value-Calibrated Warm-up and Self-Distillation
papers.q1: VLA RL can suffer catastrophic early unlearning and waste updates on low-value exploratory actions.
papers.q2: FORCE calibrates a Q-function with on-policy warm-up, then projects a value-weighted target distribution over current-policy action samples back into the policy.
papers.q3: Simulation and real-world VLA manipulation tasks.
papers.q4: The self-distillation target is constructed from action values and policy samples; it is not a separate language-model teacher providing token logits.
papers.affiliation: Peking University; Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence; Institute of Physics

papers.title: SD-Search: On-Policy Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Reasoning
papers.q1: Outcome rewards assign the same credit to every search query even though only some queries determine whether a trajectory succeeds.
papers.q2: SD-Search conditions a same-model teacher on hindsight summaries of grouped rollouts and distills its query preferences back to the inference-time student.
papers.q3: Search-augmented reasoning agents with query-level supervision layered on GRPO.
papers.q4: Hindsight summaries and grouped-rollout outcomes must reliably identify useful search decisions.
papers.affiliation: Kuaishou

papers.title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Memory systems can store experience without teaching an agent how to select, use, write and maintain reusable knowledge.
papers.q2: OPD-Evolver uses a slow-fast co-evolution loop and privileged hindsight to distill four memory-management abilities into a deployable policy.
papers.q3: Multi-domain agent-evolution benchmarks with hierarchical memory operations.
papers.q4: The memory hierarchy and outcome attribution determine which experiences become reusable skills.

papers.title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Sparse episode rewards provide weak guidance for multi-turn actions.
papers.q2: SDAR combines RL with a gated skill-conditioned self-distillation objective on student interaction trajectories.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA with Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 agents.
papers.q4: Privileged skills and teacher scoring are used during training; inference remains skill-free.
papers.scope_evidence: 环境动作和反馈构成多轮轨迹；技能条件自教师重评分学生 token，门控蒸馏与 RL 联合优化。

papers.title: Beyond Timestamps: Decision-Aligned On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.q1: Timestamp alignment can mismatch the functional decisions in sibling rollouts.
papers.q2: AlignOPSD matches decision contexts across student rollouts and turns rectified teacher evidence into hierarchical action credit.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA with Qwen2.5-3B and 7B agents.
papers.q4: Decision matching and variable-duration credit are training-time operations.
papers.scope_evidence: 真实交互轨迹中按功能决策对齐同胞 rollout；学生动作的特权重评分用于分层信用分配。

papers.title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Privileged skills can change hidden representations without strongly changing sampled-token probabilities.
papers.q2: A hindsight-conditioned self-teacher aligns projected student hidden states at each layer on the same sampled responses, alongside GRPO.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop across two model backbones.
papers.q4: Requires access to intermediate representations and a training-time hindsight skill.
papers.scope_evidence: ALFWorld/WebShop 交互；同一学生回答上的隐藏表示蒸馏，不能因没有 token-logit loss 而遗漏。

papers.title: UniOPSD: Unifying Outcome and Hindsight Feedback for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Outcome and hindsight feedback can disagree at individual agent decisions.
papers.q2: UniOPSD combines return-based credit with privileged re-scoring at shared interaction anchors, using agreement and precision to arbitrate their influence.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA with Qwen2.5 agents.
papers.q4: Successful-peer hindsight and local credit calibration are required during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 环境回报与学生交互锚点上的 hindsight 自蒸馏共同构造决策信用。

papers.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Privileged teachers can be unreliable, and their usefulness changes during agent training.
papers.q2: A separately optimized skill-conditioned teacher guides a skill-free student with RL and OPD until discrepancy and performance criteria trigger retirement.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B.
papers.q4: Requires teacher training and an estimate of teacher task success for the retirement rule.
papers.scope_evidence: 环境中先训练技能教师，再在学生交互轨迹上联合 OPD/RL，并自适应停止蒸馏。

papers.title: Reconciling Process Supervision with Outcome-Based Credit in Agentic Policy Optimization
papers.q1: Privileged token preferences do not directly specify credit for executable agent actions.
papers.q2: TASPO re-scores sampled actions with applicable privileged experience and converts likelihood shifts into bounded weights on outcome advantages.
papers.q3: Three multi-turn agentic benchmarks with execution-grounded outcome rewards.
papers.q4: The outcome determines update direction; distillation redistributes action credit instead of adding a standalone KL loss.
papers.scope_evidence: 可执行动作上的特权似然差用于重分配 RL 信用；属于交互式 OPSD 信号引导的训练。

papers.title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL
papers.q1: Routine and erroneous interaction steps need different supervision sources.
papers.q2: AHEAD conditions the teacher on environment feedback throughout the rollout and adds corrective hints at error steps to guide student updates.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-based QA across three model scales.
papers.q4: Corrective hints are generated during training and are absent from the deployed student.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生执行动作并接收环境反馈；错误步骤另加教师纠正提示进行自蒸馏。

papers.title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL
papers.q1: Teacher confidence does not establish whether a distillation update supports the RL objective.
papers.q2: ICSD calibrates distillation weights using the estimated influence of teacher-directed token changes on the RL surrogate.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA under GRPO and GiGPO.
papers.q4: The calibration is detached and redistributes the existing auxiliary loss within action turns.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生交互轨迹上的特权教师监督，用 RL 目标的局部影响校准 token 蒸馏权重。

papers.title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents
papers.q1: Skill availability does not guarantee that an agent uses the skills effectively.
papers.q2: BCSD re-scores each trajectory with augmented and reduced skill contexts and combines their token-level signals to rescale RL advantages.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop skill-based agents.
papers.q4: The augmented view uses training-time Meta-Skills; the target agent remains skill-based.
papers.scope_evidence: 在实际环境轨迹上用两种技能上下文重评分，并将自蒸馏信号并入 RL。

papers.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Local distillation signals need to reflect sequential credit across interaction turns.
papers.q2: AgentOPSD aggregates privileged teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn evidence and recursively updates a belief state for outcome-credit weighting.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA with Qwen2.5-3B and 7B.
papers.q4: Uses privileged re-scoring and recursive credit without an extra critic or rollout.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生动作—观察轨迹上聚合教师差值，并递归更新 turn-level 信用。

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
papers.q1: Replay formatting can confound the apparent benefit of future observations.
papers.q2: OCSD contrasts matched replay views with and without future observations and uses the residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA with three Qwen3 scales.
papers.q4: Future observations are privileged training evidence, not inputs available to the deployed policy.
papers.scope_evidence: 真实环境未来观察用于训练期反事实重评分；学生 token 上的自蒸馏残差信号指导 RL。

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping
papers.q1: Sparse outcomes do not identify which interaction steps deserve teacher-derived credit.
papers.q2: ADRS calibrates skill-conditioned scores on student tokens across steps, gates them by return association, and inserts them into RL reward-to-advantage construction.
papers.q3: Three interactive agent benchmarks across RL backbones and generalization settings.
papers.q4: Privileged procedural skills and within-group return statistics are training-time inputs.
papers.scope_evidence: 无技能学生交互轨迹上重评分固定动作 token，以回报相关性门控并形成密集信用。

papers.title: PCSD: Persistent Consistency for Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Isolated teacher-student token gaps can be noisy within long agent trajectories.
papers.q2: PCSD weights distillation using persistent local teacher support, adaptive windows and trend-aware gating, jointly with GRPO.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop across two backbones.
papers.q4: Requires privileged teacher scores; inference does not use skills.
papers.scope_evidence: 多轮环境轨迹上以持续一致的教师信号加权 on-policy 自蒸馏。

papers.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Single-trajectory skills can be path-specific or mismatched with current agent capabilities.
papers.q2: The policy reflects on verified sibling rollouts; a self-teacher uses their success-failure contrast to modulate turn credit on student trajectories.
papers.q3: Multiple interactive agent environments and model scales.
papers.q4: Reflection and the privileged teacher are training-time components; outcome signs are preserved.
papers.scope_evidence: 当前策略的成功/失败交互组形成特权反思，由自教师重评分并校准 turn 信用。

papers.title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.q1: Teacher preferences on student failures may not produce successful environment behavior.
papers.q2: OVCSD verifies teacher continuations from student-reached states, compares the first aligned divergence, and distills successful post-divergence behavior.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop across three model scales.
papers.q4: Uses additional privileged environment interaction to verify corrections before training.
papers.scope_evidence: 教师从学生访问状态实际执行并验证结果；局部比较学习加后缀蒸馏，非仅筛选整条成功轨迹。

papers.title: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search
papers.q1: Closed teachers expose neither logits nor compatible tokenizers for search-agent distillation.
papers.q2: An offline teacher team produces a structured search protocol that conditions a privileged student branch for dense on-policy supervision alongside RL.
papers.q3: Interleaved reasoning and retrieval across seven search-QA benchmarks.
papers.q4: The structured teacher protocol is available only during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生交替推理与检索；协议条件自教师提供学生轨迹上的 token 分布监督。

papers.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Sparse outcome rewards leave intermediate agent decisions weakly supervised.
papers.q2: The current policy extracts evolving hindsight skills from its completed trajectories and re-scores sampled actions under skill-augmented and ordinary contexts.
papers.q3: Text-based and vision-based interactive agent tasks; listed once under LLM Agentic OPD.
papers.q4: Skill analysis and privileged re-scoring add training computation but no inference-time skills.
papers.scope_evidence: 当前智能体产生交互轨迹并提炼技能；其概率变化形成 on-policy 密集蒸馏信号。

papers.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
papers.q1: A retrieved skill can help in one interaction state and mislead in another.
papers.q2: UCOB compares skill-conditioned and skill-free rollouts at shared anchors and uses the higher-return context view as the local self-teacher.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA, including continual adaptation.
papers.q4: Requires paired context views, return-to-go comparisons and skill-memory maintenance.
papers.scope_evidence: 同一任务/状态下执行双上下文策略，以环境回报确定局部蒸馏方向。

papers.title: CRAFT: Counterfactual Credit Assignment from Free Sibling Rollouts for Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: A single teacher gap does not reveal the counterfactual outcome value of an action.
papers.q2: CRAFT uses existing sibling rollouts to estimate signed counterfactual credit and adjusts distillation weights and KL direction during agentic RL.
papers.q3: Three agentic environments across four model scales.
papers.q4: Counterfactual credit is estimated from sampled sibling rollouts rather than exhaustive environment interventions.
papers.scope_evidence: 交互式学生同胞 rollout 的结果提供反事实信用，并调节特权自蒸馏。

papers.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agentic Tasks
papers.q1: OPD learns quickly but can plateau, while outcome RL improves slowly from sparse feedback.
papers.q2: ATOD anneals training from OPD toward RL and reweights distillation by turn-level teacher disagreement and uncertainty.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA across three student sizes.
papers.q4: The method introduces a training schedule and turn-level weighting controls.
papers.scope_evidence: 实际环境中的多轮学生轨迹，采用 OPD/RL 退火和 turn-level 蒸馏重加权。

papers.title: OPID: On-Policy Skill Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: External skill memories can be mismatched with the current policy's interaction states.
papers.q2: OPID extracts episode- and step-level hindsight skills from current rollouts and turns context-induced action likelihood shifts into self-distillation advantages.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-based QA.
papers.q4: Skill extraction and critical-step routing are used only during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 来自当前交互轨迹的分层技能指导同一学生动作 token 的 on-policy 重评分。

papers.title: StepOPSD: Step-Aware Online Preference Self-Distillation for Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Trajectory rewards obscure the local action that determines later success.
papers.q2: StepOPSD re-scores action-centered student segments with hindsight and converts likelihood gaps into sign-preserving, normalized step credit before GRPO.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and Search-QA with Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen2.5-3B.
papers.q4: Implements distillation-derived advantage shaping, not a standalone teacher KL actor loss.
papers.scope_evidence: 以环境动作步骤分解学生交互轨迹，将 hindsight 蒸馏信号转为 step-level 信用。

papers.title: Know When to Stop, Where to Restart: Accelerating Multi-Turn Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Full multi-turn rollouts spend computation after teacher supervision becomes unreliable.
papers.q2: STRIDE stops low-endorsement student rollouts and restarts from buffered prefixes at the weakest correct interaction turn.
papers.q3: Interactive retail and cross-domain teacher training on tau2-bench; math is a supplementary setting.
papers.q4: Uses teacher-probability thresholds and a prefix buffer during training.
papers.scope_evidence: tau2-bench 用户/工具交互，按教师支持度停止并从交互前缀重启 OPD。

papers.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Local teacher-student disagreement does not establish whether an intervention helps later behavior.
papers.q2: FutureBridge-OPD executes a short teacher bridge and validates its effect on subsequent student continuation before allocating guidance.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and ScienceWorld across student and teacher scales.
papers.q4: Future-trajectory validation requires extra continuation and teacher interaction.
papers.scope_evidence: 教师桥接与学生续行均在环境中执行，以未来轨迹验证 OPD 指导。

papers.title: UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents
papers.q1: Low-confidence actions can redirect a multi-turn student into poorly supervised states.
papers.q2: UOPD performs ordinary OPD on student turns and executes teacher corrections at uncertain turns, learning those actions with forward-KL/SFT guidance.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Search environments.
papers.q4: Mixed-policy training requires an uncertainty threshold and an intervention-rate schedule.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生及教师动作实际改变环境；保留学生 turn 的 OPD，并在不确定步骤执行纠正。

papers.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
papers.q1: Erroneous tool calls can cause cascading divergence in small tool-using agents.
papers.q2: SOD adaptively weights each tool-interaction step's distillation by step-level teacher-student divergence.
papers.q3: Tool-integrated math, science and coding tasks with small language-model students.
papers.q4: The inclusion basis is interleaved tool execution and feedback, not the math or code benchmark names alone.
papers.scope_evidence: TIR 学生实际调用工具并接收结果；逐交互步骤调整 on-policy 蒸馏强度。

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation with Curriculum Turn-level Guidance for Multi-turn Agents
papers.q1: Early student errors move multi-turn trajectories outside reliable teacher support.
papers.q2: Guided-OPD mixes teacher and student turns while gradually reducing teacher intervention to recover the student-only rollout regime.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop with Qwen3 teacher-student pairs.
papers.q4: Training uses mixed-policy trajectories controlled by a teacher-guidance curriculum.
papers.scope_evidence: 环境中混合执行教师/学生 turn，并按课程退火到学生自身交互。

papers.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
papers.q1: A single teacher limits distillation quality, especially when errors compound across tool-use turns.
papers.q2: Debating teachers produce confidence-weighted supervision on student states; step-level sampling and task-dependent divergence stabilize agentic distillation.
papers.q3: Multi-turn tau2-bench and VitaBench plus BFCL-v4; code-generation results are separate.
papers.q4: Inclusion is supported by interactive customer-service evaluation, not teacher debate alone.
papers.affiliation: Huazhong University of Science and Technology; Alibaba Group
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 §4/App.B 记录用户模拟器及最多 300 个环境步；学生工具交互上的多教师 OPD。

papers.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents
papers.q1: Inter-turn errors can cause escalating KL and unstable multi-turn agent distillation.
papers.q2: TCOD gradually expands the interaction horizon exposed to the student, providing a short-to-long temporal curriculum for OPD.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and ScienceWorld across four teacher-student pairs.
papers.q4: The trajectory-depth curriculum changes which interaction prefixes receive training exposure.
papers.scope_evidence: 在三类环境中采样学生动作—观察轨迹，按交互深度实施 OPD 课程。

papers.title: SAGE-OPD: Selective Agent-Guided Intervention for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Uniform teacher scoring can penalize valid alternatives or unreliable off-distribution histories.
papers.q2: SAGE-OPD observes environment feedback, selectively applies teacher guidance, and weights token distillation by teacher confidence.
papers.q3: Multi-turn agent environments, including ALFWorld.
papers.q4: Requires environment feedback and teacher judgments to select supervised turns.
papers.scope_evidence: 先观察动作执行反馈，再决定哪些学生 turn 接受置信度加权蒸馏。

papers.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.q1: Memory rewriting can make a teacher score an action under a state the student never observed.
papers.q2: MemOPD records each invocation's original input and sampled output, reconstructs its causal context, and packs aligned teacher supervision alongside PPO.
papers.q3: Long-horizon retrieval agents with compact memory and invocation-level context rewriting.
papers.q4: Uses stored invocation contexts for scoring; flattening rewritten histories would change the conditioning state.
papers.scope_evidence: 多轮智能体的记忆改写与外部交互；在每次真实调用的学生动作位置上作状态对齐蒸馏。

papers.title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.q1: Full-horizon rollout cost and token-level loss allocation can undertrain deep interaction turns.
papers.q2: TurnOPD controls rollout depth and progressively shifts the distillation budget toward turn-balanced supervision.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and Multi-Hop Search with task-specialized teachers.
papers.q4: Uses probe statistics and a turn-normalization schedule during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 真实环境交互上联合控制 rollout 深度与按 turn 分配的 OPD 损失。

papers.title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.q1: Coding agents can ignore constraints and execution feedback already present in their history.
papers.q2: A reminder-conditioned teacher re-scores failed student prefixes with reverse KL, while successful rollouts supply self-imitation targets.
papers.q3: Repository-level interaction on SWE-bench Verified, Pro and Multilingual.
papers.q4: Reminders are training-only; distinguish this paper from non-agent On-Policy Representation Distillation.
papers.scope_evidence: 代码智能体使用仓库工具及测试反馈；失败学生轨迹上实施 reminder-conditioned reverse-KL。

papers.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers
papers.q1: Off-the-shelf teachers can give unreliable guidance on student-induced histories.
papers.q2: An execution graph retrieves teacher histories and alternatives to condition scoring of the student's original thought-action tokens.
papers.q3: ScienceWorld, ALFWorld and WebShop.
papers.q4: Requires a reusable collection of teacher executions and graph-based retrieval.
papers.scope_evidence: 执行图中的环境历史增强教师上下文，监督学生自身交互中的 thought/action token。

papers.title: GAPD: Gold-Action Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Knowledge Base Question Answering
papers.q1: Final-answer rewards provide weak guidance for intermediate knowledge-base actions.
papers.q2: GAPD matches student and gold execution states through explored entities, then distills an aligned gold-action-conditioned self-teacher on sampled action tokens.
papers.q3: Executable KBQA agents on WebQSP, GrailQA and GraphQ.
papers.q4: Requires gold logical forms that can be converted into executable action sequences.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生执行知识库查询并观察实体反馈；状态锚点对齐后进行动作 token 自蒸馏。

papers.title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
papers.q1: Trajectory advantages cannot distinguish decisive API actions from incidental reasoning tokens.
papers.q2: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation uses verified rollout contrasts and detached teacher-student divergence to bound and reshape GRPO credit.
papers.q3: AppWorld API interaction and tau3-airline tasks.
papers.q4: Uses distillation as credit weighting rather than a separate actor-matching loss; distinct from GUI continuation SGCD.
papers.scope_evidence: AppWorld/tau3 的工具反馈闭环；学生同胞轨迹上的教师分歧构造有界 RL 信用。

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.q1: Uncontrolled pretraining data obscures how long-horizon planning is learned and consolidated.
papers.q2: Controlled interactive synthesis environments support analysis of pretraining, single-teacher OPD and multi-teacher planning consolidation.
papers.q3: Multi-turn simulated item-synthesis environments with executed actions and changing inventories.
papers.q4: Controlled synthetic environments provide mechanistic evidence rather than broad real-world task coverage.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 §2–3 的库存状态随合成动作更新；OPAD 在学生自探索交互轨迹上优化。

papers.title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: A single student continuation provides limited behavior coverage at important decisions.
papers.q2: BranchOPD resamples student continuations from informative shared prefixes and applies teacher supervision to main and branch trajectories.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop interaction, alongside a separate mathematics setting.
papers.q4: Branch selection and protocol-boundary repair add training-time controls.
papers.scope_evidence: ALFWorld/WebShop 的 turn 内决策分支与后续环境行为；对学生分支施加 OPD。

papers.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.q1: Token-wise teacher corrections may not express a complete recovery path.
papers.q2: SOPD conditions longer step-level teacher corrections on student-generated trajectories, interpolating between token-level OPD and SFT.
papers.q3: ALFWorld interaction and separate reasoning tasks.
papers.q4: Its supervision granularity varies with step length; distinguish it from SOD and StepOPSD.
papers.affiliation: Nanjing University; XingYun Lab, HUJING Digital Media & Entertainment Group; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Fudan University
papers.scope_evidence: 包含真实 ALFWorld 交互评测，以学生轨迹条件构造 step-level 蒸馏。

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
papers.q1: Fresh environment rollouts and teacher queries make multi-turn OPD expensive.
papers.q2: ReOPD samples current-student responses on replayed teacher prefixes and applies dense teacher supervision with a reliability-aware step schedule.
papers.q3: Interactive Python-tool reasoning and search environments.
papers.q4: Training performs no new tool calls; current response sampling is on-policy while environment histories are replayed.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生在回放的工具历史上重新采样回答并接受教师监督；交互任务闭环评测，训练不新执行工具。

papers.title: Building Multi-Task Agentic LLMs via Two-Phase Distillation
papers.q1: Offline expert merging can exceed student capacity, while OPD needs a useful initialization.
papers.q2: Task-specific RL experts are consolidated through offline distillation followed by on-policy refinement.
papers.q3: tau2-bench airline and telecom API/user interaction; GEM sudoku and mastermind games.
papers.q4: Only the second phase is OPD; the first phase supplies offline initialization.
papers.scope_evidence: 对话与文本游戏智能体的多任务整合；明确包含后续 on-policy 策略蒸馏阶段。

papers.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: Sequence-level defensive training can miss individual insecure output decisions.
papers.q2: A clean-input teacher scores student-generated responses to injected inputs, providing token-level defensive distillation.
papers.q3: AgentDojo tool-use evaluation across Banking, Slack, Travel and Workspace.
papers.q4: The agent result is transfer to interactive tool calling; training inputs are not claimed to be fresh agent rollouts.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 App.H 采用 AgentDojo v1.2.1 的实际工具任务与执行成功指标；不能仅因训练输入离线而排除。

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.q1: External teachers or fixed privileged prompts can constrain self-distillation quality.
papers.q2: RISE extrapolates recent RL-induced parameter or logit changes to construct a synthetic teacher, then distills it on student rollouts.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and WebShop, alongside separate math, STEM and coding experiments.
papers.q4: The teacher is derived from training history rather than a stronger external model.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 agentic 设置为 ALFWorld/WebShop；当前学生 rollout 上匹配自外推教师。

papers.title: Dense Is Not Enough: Hierarchical Supervision Allocation for Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: High local disagreement need not yield useful, learnable guidance in long-horizon tasks.
papers.q2: LENS-OPD locates a decision, validates teacher guidance through student continuation, and concentrates distillation on beneficial conflicts.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and ScienceWorld across Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 teacher-student settings.
papers.q4: Future-utility validation adds continuation work during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 教师干预收益由环境中的后续学生行为验证，再实施分层 OPD。

papers.title: DTDD: Divergence-Triggered Dynamic Distillation for Reliable On-Policy Supervision
papers.q1: Large policy gaps and compounding errors can make teacher scoring unreliable.
papers.q2: Segment-level divergence triggers teacher takeover; student prefixes retain OPD supervision while teacher recovery suffixes use behavior cloning.
papers.q3: ALFWorld and agentic coding, with separate long-form reasoning experiments.
papers.q4: Uses mixed-source trajectories and different objectives for student and teacher segments.
papers.scope_evidence: ALFWorld/代码智能体中执行教师恢复；保留学生前缀 OPD，教师段另用行为克隆。

papers.title: Revisiting On-Policy Distillation: Empirical Failure Modes and Simple Fixes
papers.q1: Sampled-token OPD can be unstable under prefix drift and tokenizer mismatch.
papers.q2: The method matches local teacher-supported distributions on student prefixes with truncated reverse KL and optional sampling/masking fixes.
papers.q3: ALFWorld plus mathematics; separate WebShop experiments in Appendix G.1.
papers.q4: Inclusion rests on the paper's actual ALFWorld/WebShop experiments, not general applicability claims.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 §4.3 与 App.G.1 明确在 ALFWorld/WebShop 训练和评测学生策略。

papers.title: On-Policy Context Distillation for Language Models
papers.q1: Useful contextual experience is lost when the prompt is removed at deployment.
papers.q2: A student samples its own responses and minimizes reverse KL to an experience- or prompt-conditioned teacher.
papers.q3: Interactive Frozen Lake and Sokoban in TextArena, plus separate reasoning and domain tasks.
papers.q4: Experiential knowledge is privileged teacher context; the deployed policy does not require it.
papers.affiliation: Microsoft Research
papers.scope_evidence: 正文训练与评测包含 TextArena 的 Frozen Lake/Sokoban 动作反馈闭环。

papers.title: TIDE: Teacher-Student Transition via Informative Distillation and Exploration for Agentic RL
papers.q1: A fixed OPD-RL mixture cannot track changing teacher usefulness across training and turns.
papers.q2: TIDE schedules the handoff toward RL from disagreement trends and allocates turn-level guidance using action value and teacher disagreement.
papers.q3: Multi-turn agents gathering information, taking actions and using environment feedback.
papers.q4: Requires disagreement and relative action-value estimates during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 交互式多轮任务中协调 OPD 与 RL，按动作价值和分歧分配 turn 监督。

papers.title: f-OPD: Stabilizing Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation with Freshness-Aware Control
papers.q1: Asynchronous agent training introduces stale student rollouts and teacher contexts.
papers.q2: Freshness-aware control regulates stale samples and accumulated policy drift while retaining asynchronous execution.
papers.q3: Tool-use and coding-agent tasks with increasing interaction horizons, plus reasoning controls.
papers.q4: Approximates the synchronous on-policy objective using freshness controls on buffered samples.
papers.scope_evidence: 工具与代码智能体的长交互轨迹上研究异步 OPD；控制 rollout/context 的陈旧偏移。

papers.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.q1: Hand-designed privileged artifacts restrict how an agent learns from experience.
papers.q2: LOPD converts retrieved experience into learned latent teacher-context tokens and distills the teacher on student-generated interaction responses.
papers.q3: EnvScaler-derived tool-interactive tasks with up to 30 environment steps; code generation is a separate setting.
papers.q4: Requires an experience retriever and a learned privileged-context module during training.
papers.affiliation: National University of Singapore; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.scope_evidence: 以任务与交互历史采样学生轨迹，latent-context 自教师提供逐前缀监督。

papers.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.q1: A reference continuation may not apply to the state actually reached by the student.
papers.q2: SMRC-SD gates distillation by state compatibility and conditions the teacher on a reached-state summary and compatible continuation.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, WebShop and FTRL tool use; transfer to BFCL and ToolHop.
papers.q4: State matching and references are training-time components removed at inference.
papers.scope_evidence: 根据学生实际到达的环境状态匹配参考，再对当前学生回答进行自蒸馏。

papers.title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
papers.q1: Privileged teacher competence can deteriorate across repeated self-distillation cycles.
papers.q2: ReSAIL selects informative interaction steps, balances their distillation losses, and retains privileged-view behavior for the next teacher cycle.
papers.q3: Closed-loop ALFWorld and TextCraft; the OEL integration freshly samples student responses on logged histories.
papers.q4: Environment histories are fixed within a cycle; the SDPO-offline integration also reuses fixed responses and is a distinct variant.
papers.affiliation: Renmin University of China
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 §3.1 明确 OEL 集成每次更新重新采样学生回答；保留该 on-policy 分支并注明回放历史。

papers.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.q1: Published agent self-distillation results use inconsistent baselines, settings and cost accounting.
papers.q2: A shared protocol compares ten self-distillation methods with GRPO across agent environments, scales, stability and measured compute.
papers.q3: ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA and WebShop; 132 reported training runs.
papers.q4: This is a comparative evaluation paper, not an additional OPD algorithm.
papers.scope_evidence: 纯比较/基准论文，直接复评交互式 Agentic OPSD；计为论文，不能计作新算法。

papers.title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
papers.q1: Multi-environment scalar rewards cannot describe rollout relationships or resolve uniform-outcome groups.
papers.q2: Shared behavioral rubrics guide online prompt-group selection and provide positive privileged context for a self-distillation teacher.
papers.q3: Joint training across diverse interactive environments and model backbones.
papers.q4: Uses an LLM rubric judge and predefined behavior vocabulary during training.
papers.scope_evidence: 跨交互环境采样学生 rollout，以正向 rubric 条件自教师提供 token-level OPSD。

papers.title: Skill-SD: Skill-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Multi-turn LLM Agents
papers.q1: Fixed answer privilege does not capture alternative valid agent strategies.
papers.q2: Skill-SD summarizes agent trajectories into teacher-only skills and combines importance-weighted reverse-KL self-distillation with RL and teacher synchronization.
papers.q3: AppWorld API interaction and Sokoban.
papers.q4: Requires trajectory-to-skill extraction during training; the student acts without skills.
papers.affiliation: vivo AI Lab; Hangzhou Institute for Advanced Study, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Science and Technology of China; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.scope_evidence: AppWorld/Sokoban 实际交互；学生轨迹上技能条件教师的 importance-weighted reverse-KL。

papers.title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
papers.q1: Final SQL correctness cannot localize which earlier database actions caused an error.
papers.q2: A hindsight teacher re-scores on-policy SQL actions with execution feedback and converts likelihood gaps into bounded GRPO weights on SQL/tool tokens.
papers.q3: Multi-turn database interaction on BIRD and Spider, including execution, verification and revision.
papers.q4: Reported selection results use multiple sampled trajectories; execution hindsight is training-only.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文定义数据库 action-observation 多轮轨迹，执行反馈用于学生 SQL/tool token 的自蒸馏信用。

papers.title: MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems
papers.q1: Team-level outcomes provide weak role-specific and coordination supervision.
papers.q2: MAS-OPD jointly distills independent role policies on team-generated trajectories, using role advantages and privileged conflict attribution.
papers.q3: Two-role multi-turn coordination on code and mathematics tasks, with peer-disagreement feedback.
papers.q4: The interaction is between agents; it is not claimed to be an external tool-execution benchmark.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 §2.1 为独立学生策略之间的多轮通信反馈闭环；联合轨迹上的 OPD，不是单模型内部 CoT。

papers.title: OVD: On-policy Verbal Distillation
papers.q1: Closed teachers cannot supply vocabulary logits for student trajectory supervision.
papers.q2: OVD verbally scores current-student segments, retains strong segments and replaces weak ones with teacher continuations before policy optimization.
papers.q3: Web search QA with simulated search during training and the live Serper API at evaluation.
papers.q4: Several reported Web-QA settings retain teacher feedback at inference; they are not standalone-student results.
papers.scope_evidence: 正文 App.A.10 明确训练期搜索模拟器与测试期 Serper 搜索交互；需区分推理时仍有教师的配置。

papers.title: Online Experiential Learning for Language Models
papers.q1: Deployment experience is often not consolidated into the language agent's parameters.
papers.q2: OEL extracts transferable knowledge from deployment trajectories and internalizes it through on-policy context distillation between deployment rounds.
papers.q3: Frozen Lake and Sokoban in TextArena across model scales and thinking modes.
papers.q4: Distillation reuses collected histories without access to the user-side environment; online refers to successive deployment-learning cycles.
papers.affiliation: Microsoft Research
papers.scope_evidence: 部署交互轨迹提炼经验，当前学生采样的回答接受 OPCD；正文评测 Frozen Lake/Sokoban。

papers.title: DASH-OPD: Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for On-Policy Distillation
papers.q1: A fixed intervention budget does not determine when an agent needs teacher takeover or student handback.
papers.q2: DASH-OPD accumulates drift and recovery evidence across interaction turns and uses hysteresis to switch between student and teacher execution.
papers.q3: Three multi-turn agent benchmarks across two student scales.
papers.q4: Training uses mixed-policy execution and separate takeover and handback thresholds.
papers.scope_evidence: 学生/教师在环境交互中双向切换执行，按连续 turn 的分歧证据进行 on-policy 蒸馏。

papers.title: From Imitation to Reward Discovery: On-Policy Warmup for Agentic RL
papers.q1: Sparse rewards leave early agent exploration with too few successful trajectories.
papers.q2: OPW first trains a student with teacher supervision on its own interaction trajectories, then transitions to reward-based reinforcement learning.
papers.q3: Interactive agent benchmarks with imperfect actions and recovery states in the warmup distribution.
papers.q4: OPD is a warmup stage rather than an objective retained throughout subsequent RL.
papers.scope_evidence: 先在学生自己访问的交互状态上进行 reverse-KL 蒸馏，再切换到 Agentic RL。

papers.title: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
papers.strict: state-level distillation on collected student rollouts
papers.q1: Offline teacher demonstrations can mismatch both the states and writing style of a web-agent student.
papers.q2: WebKD rewrites individual responses at states reached by the student, using student-style corrections, action-aware reasoning weights and a role-asymmetric KL anchor.
papers.q3: TimeWarp web tasks and live-web transfer on OnlineMind2Web.
papers.q4: Uses a fixed pool collected by the behavior-cloned student; this is state-level correction, not fresh token-level OPD at every update.
papers.affiliation: University of Utah
papers.scope_evidence: 正文明确每个教师改写都对齐学生实际访问的状态，避免教师接管后的新状态；以固定学生状态池上的动作级蒸馏收录并注明。
